cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: You Handle the Impossible Part
cards.instruction: Make someone accept responsibility for the one part of the plan that cannot reasonably be done.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You've set out jars, so I've labelled one 'yesterday'. You fill it with the missing hour; we'll have a longer lunch.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm setting out jam for tasting. Time doesn't fit in jars.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Jars ready, then. Loosen the lid; give the hour room to get in.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You collect it. I'll do the labels.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've already put 'collected by you' on this one. What should I write for the collection time?

reason: Use copied preservation setup to assign time collection for lunch; reject B role swap through named label rather than repeat the a alternative workload bargain.
